MATCH (t:Team) 
WHERE t.id = $team_id
RETURN t.name AS team_name, t.contact_email AS contact_email, t.contact_phone AS contact_phone, t.team_address AS team_address, t.team_type AS team_type, t.created_at AS created_at, t.updated_at AS updated_at 
LIMIT 100

MATCH (t:Team) 
WHERE t.id = $team_id
MATCH (u:User) 
WHERE u.current_team_id = t.id 
OPTIONAL MATCH (tr:TeamRole) 
WHERE tr.team_id = t.id AND tr.user_id = u.id 
RETURN u.name AS member_name, u.email AS member_email, tr.role AS role 
LIMIT 100

MATCH (u:Unit) WHERE u.name = "<unit>"
MATCH (u)-[:UNION]->(un:Union) WHERE un.team_id IN $ai_team_ids
OPTIONAL MATCH (i:Invoice) WHERE i.customer_type = "unit" AND i.customer_id = u.id AND toFloat(i.calc_due_amount) > 0
RETURN u.id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, un.name AS union_name, sum(toFloat(i.calc_due_amount)) AS balance, count(i) AS open_invoices

MATCH (a:Account)-[:BELONGS_TO_UNION]->(u:Union) 
WHERE u.team_id IN $ai_team_ids 
OPTIONAL MATCH (ab:AccountBalance)-[:ACCOUNT]->(a) 
RETURN a.name AS account_name, sum(toFloat(ab.credit_balance)) - sum(toFloat(ab.debit_balance)) AS balance 
LIMIT 100

MATCH (u:Unit) WHERE u.name = "<unit>" 
MATCH (u)-[:UNION]->(un:Union) 
OPTIONAL MATCH (i:Invoice) 
WHERE i.customer_type = "unit" AND i.customer_id = u.id AND toFloat(i.calc_due_amount) > 0 
RETURN u.id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, un.name AS union_name, sum(toFloat(i.calc_due_amount)) AS balance, count(i) AS open_invoices 
LIMIT 100

MATCH (b:BoardMember)-[:BELONGS_TO_UNION]->(un:Union)
WHERE un.team_id IN $ai_team_ids AND un.deleted_at IS NULL
WITH un, max(b.year) AS latest_year
MATCH (cur:BoardMember)-[:BELONGS_TO_UNION]->(un)
WHERE cur.year = latest_year
MATCH (cur)-[:BELONGS_TO_CONTACT]->(c:Contact)
RETURN un.name AS union_name, c.first_name, c.last_name, cur.bm_role, cur.year
ORDER BY un.name

MATCH (b:Bill)-[:BELONGS_TO_UNION]->(u:Union) 
WHERE toFloat(b.calc_due_amount) > 0 AND u.team_id IN $ai_team_ids 
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[:SUPPLIER]->(s:Supplier) 
RETURN sum(toFloat(b.calc_due_amount)) AS total_payable, count(DISTINCT b) AS open_bills, collect(DISTINCT s.name)[..10] AS suppliers

OPTIONAL MATCH (tr:TeamRole) WHERE tr.user_id = u.id AND tr.team_id = t.id
